impact: An agent can end a turn without fixing findings. 1. d854fea: an identical Stop block releases after 2 repeats (stop_stall.py:13, DEFAULT_LIMIT 2). 2. 38fd461: past 500 tracked paths the oldest pending blockers are dropped (blocker_state.py:18,148). 3. 23e971e: a skipped Sonnet candidate counts as clean (claude_sonnet.py:146), a queued row drops after 2 failures, a CLI failure gives 300 s of silence (turn_retry.py:17,20). 4. f0c6874: OMP JS eval and unknown tools run first and are only scanned afterwards (pi tool-adapter.ts:243-283). Also 3fca7d2: Codex Luna login/config/transport failures still fail open. Each needs a user decision: keep, or restore the block.
title: Weakening commits since 2026-08-01 still in HEAD without a measured reason
